messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: Model comparison
parts:
Hi Paul,
 When I've run these bivariate smooth spatial models in MGCV and GAM, we typically use a likelihood ratio test

 I've been trying to figure out a comparable alternative with brm fits. WAIC does not seem to be fully explanatory for the difference we see in adjusted vs unadjusted models.

 The maps may tell enough of the story, but what is the best global measure to compare these models?

 In this case the difference in WAIC is small, half the size of the standard error.
